fields.description: Violet 4 is a collection of four-bedroom townhouses in DAMAC Hills 2. Private gardens and roof terraces give the homes outdoor space, while the wider community provides water attractions, sports facilities and everyday shopping. The original release and later Violet 4 Phase 3 have different published programmes.

overview: Both townhouse drawings place a study beside the ground-floor kitchen and living area, with bedrooms arranged across the first and roof floors. The end layout has a different garden footprint. The plan table separately identifies garage, balcony and terrace area, so total saleable area should not be read as enclosed internal floor space.
research.locationNote: Violet 4 is within DAMAC Hills 2 in Dubailand, accessed through the wider community's road network. Its launch material positions it opposite Water Town. Check the actual townhouse, routes to community facilities and daily commute rather than relying on generic driving-time claims.
research.priceNote: The original fact sheet starts at AED 1.96m, rounded to two decimal places. Property Finder gives an original launch reference of AED 1.958m. Neither establishes current developer stock or a present resale offer; request the selected home's dated quotation and costs.
research.paymentNote: The original 60/ 40 launch structure includes 20% immediately, 36% in timed instalments, 2% at each of the 80% and 90% construction milestones, and 40% on completion. Grouped monthly entries below preserve the original schedule. Later release or resale terms require separate confirmation.
research.handoverNote: The original fact sheet anticipates August 2027, corroborated by the original Property Finder entry. Its separate Violet 4 Phase 3 entry reports Q4 2028; that later programme must not be transferred to every original-release home.
